newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch arrest suspected kidnapper of German girls.
newsitem.headline: Dutch arrest suspected kidnapper of German girls.

text.p: Dutch police said on Friday they had found four missing German girls and arrested a German man suspected of abducting them.
The four, twin girls of 12 and two friends aged 10 and l1 years respectively, were found in the man's car and appeared to be unharmed, police spokesman Jan van Mourik said.
"A German man aged 45 was arrested at the request of German police on suspicion of kidnapping the four girls," he said.
The suspect and the children had been stopped while driving near the south western Dutch town of Oostburg.
Dutch authorities are processing a German extradition request for the man, thought to be a former live-in partner of the mother of the twins, the spokesman added.
The children were reported missing in Cologne on Wednesday after failing to return home from a playground.
Van Mourik was unable to say whether the children had been abducted against their will. The children appeared to be unharmed, but were being given professional care, he said.
